name: Arthurs Views
signature: Five suites with panoramic Port Phillip Bay views from Arthurs Seat ridge — adults-only, double spas, electric log fires
editorNote:
Five suites on the Arthurs Seat ridge with panoramic Port Phillip Bay views, double spas, and electric log fires. AAA 4.5-star rated. Adults-only, child-free. Hosts Helen and Greg.

From approximately $265–$330 per night, peak from $369. Arthurs Seat is the geographic mid-point of the Peninsula — convenient for day trips in both directions. Confirm minimum stay and current condition before booking; a January 2025 review noted minor maintenance concerns.
whyWeGo: Panoramic Port Phillip Bay views from Arthurs Seat — the Peninsula's most panoramic B&B position.
ifOnlyOneThing: Request a suite with the north-facing bay view rather than the garden-facing room.
